identity_notes: Official Sakana project page links SakanaAI/AI-Scientist-v3 and explicitly distinguishes this next-generation system from The AI Scientist v1 and v2. Official project page publication: October 2026. This collection is not AI-Scientist-v2.
selection_notes: Collected every distinct complete generated/co-generated research manuscript officially linked or embedded by the Sakana Agentic Scientist project page: two autonomous sampled papers and one explicitly human-agent co-discovered ALIFE paper. Checked the official repository recursively (no PDFs), GitHub releases (none), and all PDFs in the 31,445,595-byte official arXiv source archive 2610.18933v1. Source assets confirm the same three works; two are byte-identical to the website PDFs. Preserved website PDF response bytes without re-rendering or extraction. Deduplicated work-level variants, previews, revision diffs, figures, and human-authored reference/baseline papers. The system description itself was inspected but is not counted/downloaded as generated research output. A 70-campaign benchmark is reported; no public complete 70-manuscript collection was located. Metadata reflects publicly available sources checked October 26, 2026 America/Chicago. Primary comparative eligibility is restricted to the two autonomous case studies. The substantially human-assisted Diffusing Blame work is retained in a separate co_discovery appendix folder with eligible_primary=false.

papers.provenance: Official Sakana project page embeds this camera-ready manuscript and links arXiv:2606.31700. It explicitly describes co-discovery using a development version of The Agentic Scientist: human scientists set direction/constraints, steered experiments, checked implementations/results/references/claims, and revised the agent-organized manuscript. Accepted as an ALIFE 2026 oral presentation. It is included as co-generated output, not as a fully autonomous manuscript or a human-authored baseline. published_date is the related arXiv work initial submission date (June 30, 2026), not a claim about this exact website PDF release date. A differently compressed/compiled camera-ready file occurs as assets/alife2026_camera_ready.pdf in arXiv source archive 2610.18933v1; that duplicate work was not saved separately.
